description: This PHP class JsonCompiler is responsible for loading JSON files and compiling them into PHP arrays, primarily used internally within the AWS SDK PHP package. It provides an interface to load JSON content either from cache or directly from a file.

classes.name: JsonCompiler
classes.description: A utility class to load and compile JSON files into PHP arrays, marked for internal use and deprecated.

methods.name: load
methods.description: Loads a JSON file from cache or directly from the file system using the function load_compiled_json.
